200.description: Cycle count recorded and reconciled (discrepancy indicates whether counted quantity differed from system quantity).

systemQuantity.description: Quantity system records show for this bin prior to reconciliation.

discrepancy.description: True if countedQuantity differed from systemQuantity.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, ONLY when this response is a replay of the stored answer for the request's Idempotency-Key (the handler did not run again). The first execution of a key never carries it.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, binId path segment missing/empty, or the body omits countedQuantity (an explicit 0 is a valid empty-bin count; omitting the field is a client mistake). A missing or malformed Idempotency-Key header is also a 400 (idempotency-key-required / idempotency-key-invalid).
